description: Figure 2 is a bar chart that compares the average accuracy across 11 datasets for different training methods, with training methods plotted along the x-axis and average accuracy on the y-axis. The chart visually presents the performance of several training approaches, including Self-RAG, FactTune, CINGS (w/ CONTEXT SUP.), and CINGS, all built on the Llama 2 base model. The bars are arranged horizontally, with each bar representing a distinct training method. The height of each bar corresponds to the average accuracy achieved on the 11 datasets, allowing for a direct visual comparison of performance. The chart demonstrates that models trained with CINGS consistently outperform the others, with CINGS achieving the highest average accuracy, followed by CINGS (w/ CONTEXT SUP.), FactTune, and Self-RAG. The bar for CINGS is visibly taller than the others, indicating a significant performance advantage. The chart does not include numerical labels on the bars or gridlines, relying on relative bar heights for comparison. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets,” and the x-axis is labeled “each training method,” with method names listed beneath each bar. The chart is rendered in grayscale, with each bar shaded in a uniform light gray tone.
